Convert an anatModel to a data.frame

Source: R/minc_anatomy.R
as.data.frame.anatModel.Rd

Convert an anatModel to a data.frame

Usage

# S3 method for class 'anatModel'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  ...,
  structure_column = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An anatModel object, for example from anatLm or anatAnova

row.names, optional

Passed to as.data.frame

...

additional parameters for methods

structure_column

If a string, the structure names (the row names of x) are also put in a column with this name, as the first column. This keeps the names when you use tools that drop row names, for example dplyr::filter. The default NULL adds no column.

Value

A data.frame with one row for each structure

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fits <- anatLm(~ Sex, gf, vols)
as.data.frame(fits, structure_column = "Structure") %>%
  dplyr::filter(`tvalue-SexM` > 3)
} # }
